description: Read every checklist on a trip with its items. Returns each checklist's title and, for every task, a stable itemId, text, category (section heading), position (0-based stored order; the app groups tasks under their section headings in first-appearance order), isChecked (complete for everyone on a shared trip) and checkedByMe (on a shared trip a task you ticked stays unchecked until every traveler ticks it). Tasks are a flat list: there are no subtasks or nested items. Pass checklist_id (the checklist's segment ID) to read just one checklist. Call this before editing items so you have the item IDs. To create a checklist use segment_create (type Note, isChecklist true, checklistItems [{text, category?}]). To change tasks use checklist_items_add (append tasks), checklist_item_update (text, category, or checked to mark done/not done), checklist_items_remove, or checklist_items_reorder, passing checklist_id and the item IDs. Delete a whole checklist with segment_delete. Never show IDs to users.

checklist_id.description: Optional. The checklist note's segment ID, to read just that one checklist.
